summary: Implements a node selector that prefers nodes whose reported CPU load is below a configured threshold before applying sorted selection.
responsibilities: Filter unavailable nodes before CPU load evaluation.
Prefer nodes below the configured CPU load limit when any exist.
Delegate final node selection to shared sorted selection utilities.

summary: Node selector that filters candidates by CPU load before sorting and algorithm selection.

inner.summary: CPU load threshold used to prefer low-load nodes.

summary: Filters to available nodes and narrows candidates to nodes below CPU load limit when at least one low-load node exists.
summary_step: 1. Filters input nodes to currently available serving nodes.
2. Returns ErrNoAvailableNodes when no candidates remain.
3. Builds a preferred list of nodes whose CPU load is below CPULoadLimit.
4. Uses the preferred low-load list only when it is non-empty, otherwise keeps all available nodes.

summary: Filters candidate nodes by CPU load and delegates final selection to shared sorted selection.
